summary: Phase 136P, Implementation Group 5. Implemented exactly PublicationAttempt and PublicationEvidence executable schemas per CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 v1.0 Sec.25/26, plus the embedded cas_expectation shared definition's third and final embedding site (Sec.24), resolving the deferral shared/references.schema.json itself disclosed since Phase 136N. Independently re-derived the exact Group 5 inventory from the frozen contract's own Sec.46 grouping table rather than the active task prompt's expected inventory (PublicationAttempt, PublicationEvidence, ConcurrencyConflict): Sec.46 places ConcurrencyConflict in an atomic pair with RecoveryJournalEntry (contract-group 8), and the task's own Strict 136P No-Go Boundary explicitly forbids RecoveryJournalEntry, so splitting that pair to satisfy the task prompt's suggestion would have violated CSCH-EXEC-REQ-062's per-group atomicity requirement -- documented as a discrepancy rather than silently broadened. Followed Sec.25/26's literal field tables. Independently confirmed the ref/identity/digest graphs are acyclic; no PublicationAttempt-v2 or PublicationEvidence-v2 mechanism was needed. Disclosed 2 new NON-BLOCKING findings (NON-BLOCKING-136P-1: temporary_pointer_reference's undisclosed Sec.16 trigger; NON-BLOCKING-136P-2: PublicationEvidence's conditional-authoritative exception not locally schema-enforced, mirroring NON-BLOCKING-136J-1). Every declared Group 5 manifest dependency confirmed to be an actual $ref target; no new spurious-dependency instance introduced (the existing Group 4 instance on human_authorization/certification was left unrepaired, per this phase's own scope boundary). Added 113 new focused tests (tests/test_cltr_cutover_136p_publication_schema.py). Migrated 8 earlier phases' scope-guard tests (136H through 136O) plus test_schema_runtime_boundaries/packaging to recognize Group 5 as legitimate. Combined test_cltr_cutover_136h through 136p + test_schema_runtime_* suite: 1121 passed, 0 failed (1008 non-slow + 113 new + 4 slow packaging). Fast Green: 4391 passed, identical to the 136H-136O baseline, zero regressions. Full unmarked suite freshly run: 20536 passed, 21 failed, 20557 total -- all 21 failures independently confirmed inherited and unrelated to Phase 136P (none reference schema_resources/schema_runtime/cltr_cutover; identical failing test files to the 136M/136N/136O established inherited-failure baseline). Fresh wheel/sdist build and packaging verification passed. Legacy lifecycle remains the sole production authority; CLTR remains derivative; runtime remains Observed / observe / execution unavailable. No RecoveryJournal, ConcurrencyConflict, ReconciliationResult, Quarantine, notification/marker/receipt binding, CompatibilityState, HistoricalAuthorityReference, typed model, semantic validator, or authority resolver/state/pointer was created or changed by Phase 136P. Verdict: COMPLETED -- READY FOR PUBLICATION SCHEMA INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION. Recommended next phase: 136Q -- Publication Schema Independent Verification.
